children.name: ansible.cfg
children.content:
[defaults]
inventory = ./hosts.ini
remote_user = devops
host_key_checking = False
retry_files_enabled = False
forks = 20

[privilege_escalation]
become = True
become_method = sudo
become_user = root
become_ask_pass = False

[ssh_connection]
pipelining = True
control_path = %(directory)s/ansible-ssh-%%h-%%p-%%r

children.name: hosts.ini
children.content:
[webservers]
web1.trak.internal ansible_host=192.168.1.10
web2.trak.internal ansible_host=192.168.1.11

[databases]
db1.trak.internal ansible_host=192.168.1.20

[production:children]
webservers
databases

[production:vars]
ansible_python_interpreter=/usr/bin/python3
environment_name=production

children.name: playbook.yml
children.content:
---
- name: Configure Production Web Servers
  hosts: webservers
  become: true
  vars:
    http_port: 80
    app_name: trak-api

  tasks:
    - name: Ensure Nginx is installed
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name: nginx
        state: present

    - name: Deploy application landing template
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: index.html.j2
        dest: /var/www/html/index.html
        owner: www-data
        group: www-data
        mode: '0644'
      notify: Restart Nginx

  handlers:
    - name: Restart Nginx
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: nginx
        state: restarted

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 🔴 Ansible Automation, Roles & Configuration Mastery Track

Welcome to the **Ansible Automation, Roles & Configuration Mastery Track** materialized by **Trak**.

This workspace is an in-depth curriculum covering agentless SSH architecture, dynamic inventory management, Playbooks, Jinja2 templating, reusable Roles, Vault secret encryption, error handling with blocks/rescue, and Molecule testing.

## 📚 Syllabus & Module Map

| Module | Title | Key Topics & Internals |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `00-setup-and-agentless-architecture` | Agentless Architecture | Push-based SSH execution, Python interpreter, `ansible.cfg` tuning |
| `01-inventory-management-and-groups` | Inventories & Groups | INI/YAML formats, dynamic inventory plugins (AWS/GCP), `all:children` |
| `02-ad-hoc-commands` | Ad-Hoc Commands | `ansible -m ping`, `ansible -m command`, `ansible -m setup`, parallel forks |
| `03-playbooks-structure-and-yaml` | Playbook Structure | `hosts`, `become`, `vars`, `tasks`, task naming conventions, idempotency |
| `04-core-modules-file-copy-systemd` | Core Modules | `copy`, `template`, `file`, `systemd`, `package`, `user`, `lineinfile` |
| `05-variables-precedence-and-facts` | Variables & Facts | 22-level precedence hierarchy, `ansible_facts`, `group_vars`, `host_vars` |
| `06-handlers-and-notify` | Event-Driven Handlers | `notify: Handler Name`, handler execution timing, `meta: flush_handlers` |
| `07-conditionals-and-when-clauses` | Conditionals & Logic | `when:` conditions, `failed_when`, `changed_when`, register output checks |
| `08-loops-and-iterators` | Loops & Iterations | `loop:` over lists and maps, `loop_control` with `label` and `index_var` |
| `09-jinja2-templating-and-filters` | Jinja2 Templates & Filters | `{{ variable }}`, filters (`default`, `to_json`, `ipaddr`), loop structures |
| `10-roles-and-reusable-structure` | Role Architecture | `tasks/`, `handlers/`, `templates/`, `defaults/`, `meta/main.yml`, dependencies |
| `11-ansible-galaxy-and-collections` | Galaxy & Collections | `ansible-galaxy`, `requirements.yml`, FQCN (Fully Qualified Collection Names) |
| `12-ansible-vault-and-encryption` | Ansible Vault Secrets | `ansible-vault encrypt`, `--vault-password-file`, encrypted string variables |
| `13-error-handling-blocks-and-rescue` | Exception Handling | `block:`, `rescue:` exception recovery, `always:` cleanup tasks |
| `14-delegation-and-rolling-updates` | Delegation & Rolling Updates | `delegate_to: localhost`, `run_once: true`, `serial: "20%"` zero-downtime rolling |
| `15-testing-with-molecule-and-ansible-lint` | Molecule & Linting | Molecule test suites with Docker driver, Testinfra, `ansible-lint` rules |
| `16-ansible-automation-platform-awx` | AWX & AAP Orchestration | AWX web UI, Execution Environments (EE), RBAC, Webhooks, Job Templates |
| `17-performance-tuning-and-ssh-pipelining` | Performance Tuning | `pipelining = True`, `forks = 50`, ControlMaster persistent connections |
| `18-interview-questions-and-drills` | Interview Mastery Drills | Top 10 Ansible SRE gotchas + Production Multi-Tier Server Provisioning Drill |

---

## 🛠️ How to Practice
Each module contains:
- `README.md` — Deep theoretical explanation and architecture notes.
- `playbook.yml` — Fully runnable concept demonstration.
- `exercise/starter.yml` — Hands-on problem with `TODO` markers.
- `exercise/solution.yml` — Complete reference solution.

# 08 — Loops & `loop_control`

- name: Create directories

# 10 — Ansible Role Architecture

## 🎯 Standard Directory Layout
```text
roles/my_role/
├── defaults/main.yml  # Lowest priority fallback vars
├── files/             # Static files
├── handlers/main.yml  # Notification handlers
├── meta/main.yml      # Author & role dependencies
├── tasks/main.yml     # Entry point tasks
├── templates/         # Jinja2 template files
└── vars/main.yml      # High priority role vars
```

# 13 — Exception Handling with `block` & `rescue`

## 🎯 Try / Catch / Finally in Ansible
```yaml
- name: Critical Operation with Rollback
  block:
    - name: Apply DB Migration
      ansible.builtin.command: /opt/migrate.sh
  rescue:
    - name: Rollback DB Migration on failure
      ansible.builtin.command: /opt/rollback.sh
  always:
    - name: Send Notification
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "Migration run completed."
```

# 18 — High-Yield Ansible SRE Interview Drills

## 🧠 Top 10 Gotchas
1. **Breaking Idempotency with `shell`**: Using `command` or `shell` without `creates:` or `changed_when:` causes tasks to always report changed.
2. **Variable Precedence Conflicts**: Extra vars (`-e`) override everything, making playbooks non-reproducible if misused.
3. **Handler Execution Order**: Handlers run in the order they are defined in `handlers/main.yml`, NOT in the order notified.
4. **`ignore_errors: true` vs `failed_when`**: Prefer `failed_when` to explicitly define criteria for success and failure.
5. **Pipelining with `requiretty`**: SSH pipelining fails if `/etc/sudoers` on target node has `Defaults requiretty` enabled.
6. **`copy` vs `synchronize`**: Use `ansible.posix.synchronize` (rsync) for large directories (100x faster than `copy`).
7. **Role Defaults vs Vars**: Use `defaults/main.yml` for user-overridable variables; use `vars/main.yml` for immutable internal role constants.
8. **Gathering Facts Overhead**: Disable facts (`gather_facts: false`) on playbooks that don't need system facts to save seconds per host.
9. **Delegation Fact Scope**: Delegating a task updates facts for the original host, not the delegated host unless explicitly specified.
10. **Vault Secret in Logs**: Tasks echoing variables containing secrets will print plain text to stdout unless protected with `no_log: true`.
